title: "Quiche"
description: |
  Eggs, milk, spices and some ham makes a delicious lunch or dinner.
date: 2022-01-16
categories:
  - eggs
---

## Ingredients

* 1 pie crust, warmed to room temperature
* 6 large eggs
* 3/4 cup of milk
* dash of dried dill
* pepper
* 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese
* 3 - 4 slices of cooked bacon, chopped small


## Directions

* Preheat oven to 375F.
* Break **6** large eggs into a large bowl and scramble well.
* Add **3/4 cup** milk to eggs and mix thoroughly.
* Add **dashes** of dried dill and ground black pepper.
* Pour egg mixture into pie crust.
* Drop your chopped bacon into the egg mixture.
* Shred **1/4** cup of cheddar cheese and drop into 1/2 of the egg mixture.

* Bake at 375F for 35 - 45 minutes.
* Quiche is done when middle is set and stops jiggling.

**Note:** this is how I prepare a quiche in our 2/5 lactose intolerant family, where we add cheese to only 1/2 of the quiche so they can eat the portion with just bacon.
